s1.text: Authorize your accounts in a few clicks. Your access is encrypted and never visible to your browser.

s2.title: Schedule

s3.title: Reply
s3.text: Messages and comments arrive live in the inbox, sorted by urgency.

s4.title: Follow up
s4.text: Open, pending, closed: every conversation has a status and an owner.

features.title: Everything you need to <accent>manage your networks</accent>, nothing more

inbox.title: Unified inbox
inbox.text: Private messages and comments, updated in real time, with search across the whole history.

calendar.title: Publishing calendar
calendar.text: An overview of what goes out, when and where. Drafts, scheduled, published, errors.

team.text: Share conversations across the team and keep the context in view.

mobile.text: Reply from your phone and get a notification for every new message.

channels.title: Six networks, <accent>with full transparency</accent>
channels.text: Each network decides what third-party tools are allowed to do. We tell you plainly what works today, what is coming, and what is not possible.

isolation.title: Isolation per organization
isolation.text: Each team only sees its own data: the separation is enforced in the database itself, not just in the interface.

tokens.title: Protected network access
tokens.text: The access tokens for your accounts are encrypted before being stored, and are never sent to your browser.

openSource.title: Open-source software
openSource.text: Postbiz is published under the AGPL-3.0 license: you can read the code, and host it yourself if you wish.

faq.title: You may be <accent>wondering</accent>
faq.a1: Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube for publishing. For the inbox, coverage depends on what each network allows: see the Channels page for network-by-network details.
faq.q2: Can I reply to private messages on LinkedIn or YouTube?
faq.a2: No, and no third-party tool can without a special agreement: LinkedIn does not open its messaging to apps, and YouTube has no private messages. Postbiz will show YouTube comments, and LinkedIn Page comments as soon as they are available.
faq.a3: On Messenger and Instagram, Meta lets a business reply for 24 hours after the customer’s last message. Postbiz shows the time left on every conversation so you know what to handle first.
faq.q4: Are my messages used to train an AI?
faq.a4: No. Postbiz does not use your messages or posts to train models.
faq.a5: The beta is free, no credit card needed. The price list is already public on the Pricing page, so you know what to expect.
faq.a6: Yes. Postbiz is open-source software (AGPL-3.0) built on Supabase. If you modify it and offer it to third parties, you must publish your changes.

s1.p: Postbiz is published by [COMPANY NAME], [legal form], [address], registered under number [REGISTRATION NUMBER]. These terms govern the use of the Postbiz service, which lets you schedule posts and manage the messages and comments of social media accounts that the user has connected.

s2.p: The user creates an account with a valid e-mail address and keeps their credentials safe. They are responsible for actions taken from their account and by the members they invite to their organization.

s3.p1: Postbiz acts on the accounts the user authorizes, through the official interfaces of Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube. The user remains bound by each network’s terms (for example, the 24-hour window for replying to messages on Messenger and Instagram) and guarantees that they hold the necessary rights over the content they publish.
s3.p2: Available features depend on the permissions granted by each network, which may change or be withdrawn. Postbiz does not guarantee that a given feature will be available on a given network.

s4.p: The user must not use the service unlawfully, in particular to send unsolicited bulk messages, to distribute illegal content or content that breaks the networks’ rules, or to attempt to bypass technical or security limits.

s5.p: During the beta period, the service is provided free of charge. The prices published on the Pricing page will apply at the end of the beta, after the user has been notified at least [30] days in advance. [Billing, cancellation and refund terms to be completed when payments are enabled.]

s6.p: Postbiz uses reasonable means to keep the service running, without guaranteeing that it will never be interrupted. [Limitation of liability to be completed.]

s7.p: The user may delete their account at any time. Postbiz may suspend an account that breaches these terms or the rules of a third-party network.

s8.p: The source code of Postbiz is published under the GNU AGPL-3.0 license. That license governs the code; these terms govern the service hosted by the publisher.

s9.p1: French law. [Competent court to be completed.]

s2.li1: Account: e-mail address, display name, password (stored in encrypted form by our authentication provider).
s2.li2: Connected channels: account identifier, name and picture, and the access tokens provided by the network (encrypted before storage).
s2.li3: Messages and comments: content received and sent on the accounts you connect, as well as the public identifier, name and username of the people who write to you.
s2.li4: Posts: the texts, media and dates you schedule.
s2.li5: Usage: technical logs needed for security and for the service to work properly.

s3.li1: Providing the service (performance of the contract).
s3.li2: Ensuring security and preventing abuse (legitimate interest).
s3.p: We do not use your messages or posts to train artificial intelligence models, and we do not sell them.

s4.li1: Supabase Inc. — database, authentication and storage [hosting region: to be completed].
s4.li2: [Application and worker host: to be completed].
s4.p: The social networks you connect are separate data controllers, governed by their own policies.

s5.p: Account data is kept as long as the account exists. Messages and comments are deleted when you disconnect the channel concerned or delete your account, within [30] days. [To be adjusted.]

s6.p: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction and portability of your data, and object to its processing, by writing to <mail>{email}</mail>. You may also lodge a complaint with your data protection authority.

s7.p: Data is isolated per organization at the database level, access tokens are encrypted, and traffic is encrypted. As no system is infallible, we will inform you of any incident affecting your data.

s1.p: In Postbiz, open Channels, choose the channel, then Disconnect. Access tokens are deleted immediately, and the related conversations and messages within [30] days.

s2.p: In Settings, choose Delete my account. Your profile, the organizations of which you are the only administrator and all associated data are deleted within [30] days.

s3.h: You removed Postbiz from Facebook or Instagram
s3.p: If you remove the Postbiz app from your Facebook or Instagram account settings, we stop receiving your data and delete the matching tokens. To ask for the erasure of conversations already stored, write to us with the name of the account concerned.

s4.p: Write to <mail>{email}</mail> from your account’s address. We confirm the deletion by reply.

channelsPage.title: What works, what is coming, <accent>and what is not possible</accent>
channelsPage.intro: Each network decides what third-party tools are allowed to do. Rather than promise a “universal” inbox, here is the real status, network by network.
channelsPage.footnote: “Beta”: available to testers. “Soon”: planned, subject to the access granted by the network.

why1.title: Why not all messages?
why1.text: LinkedIn and YouTube do not give third-party apps access to private messages. We do not work around these rules: it would put your accounts at risk.

why2.title: Why this 24-hour window?
why2.text: It is a Meta rule for Messenger and Instagram. Postbiz shows the time left for each conversation.

why3.title: Missing a network?
why3.text: Tell us which one and why: our priorities follow what you actually use.

productInbox.title: All your messages and comments, <accent>in a single list</accent>
productInbox.intro: No more jumping from one app to another. Messenger, Instagram and the comments on your posts arrive live in Postbiz, with the context to reply fast and well.

p1.title: Live
p1.text: New messages appear without reloading the page, on the web and on mobile.

p2.title: The 24-hour window, visible
p2.text: Each Messenger or Instagram conversation shows the time left to reply, and the most urgent ones come first.

p3.title: Built for teams
p3.text: Assign a conversation, leave an internal note, use quick replies, change the status: open, pending, closed.

p4.title: Search the whole history
p4.text: Find a conversation by a word, a name or a username.

p5.title: Messages and comments together
p5.text: Reply to a public comment, then continue in a private message, without losing the thread.

p6.title: Transparent about limits
p6.text: LinkedIn and YouTube do not open their private messages: we say so, instead of hiding it.

productInbox.ctaTitle: Reply to every message, at the right time

productPlanning.title: Write once, <accent>publish everywhere</accent>
productPlanning.intro: Choose your networks and the time, and let Postbiz publish for you. A calendar shows what goes out, when, and what failed.

p1.title: One piece of content, several networks
p1.text: Adapt the text per network if needed, and check the constraints (length, media) before sending.

p2.title: Never a duplicate
p2.text: If the result of a post is uncertain, Postbiz does not resend it on its own: it tells you, so you can check on the network first.

p3.title: Adapted media
p3.text: Images and videos are converted to each network’s requirements before publishing.

p4.title: Drafts and clear states
p4.text: Draft, scheduled, in progress, published, error: you always know where each post stands.

p5.title: Teamwork
p5.text: Members prepare, administrators approve; permissions are enforced by the database.

p6.title: Guided reconnection
p6.text: If access to an account expires, you are notified and reconnect in one click.
